The '''1962–63 Scottish Division One''' was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by nine points over nearest rival [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]]. [[Clyde F.C.|Clyde]] and [[Raith Rovers F.C.|Raith Rovers]] finished 17th and 18th respectively and were relegated to the [[1963–64 Scottish Division Two|1963-64 Second Division]].
